blockingIssues.description: The reviewed fix exempts focused native `<select>` elements from dashboard unwind entirely, which preserves the first Escape for native dismissal but breaks the broader unwind contract while focus remains on the select.

The updated regression test accepts the filter panel remaining open on Escape from the focused select and only closes it on a later Escape, so the test encodes the regression instead of proving the intended behavior.
